statement.zh: Moseley 1992 回顾并重申「海洋奠基」多线演化模型——仍属假说，不能单独定论北奇科政治类型。
statement.en: Moseley 1992 retrospects and restates the maritime-foundations multilinear model — still a hypothesis; it does not alone settle Norte Chico political typology.

disclaimer: HYPOTHESIS — maritime-foundations remains a scholarly model; fact column records dated monumental/residential evidence separately.
